senses.gloss:
मि €5 U. (मिनोति, मिनुते; rarely used in classical literature)
—1 To throw, cast, scatter.
—2 To build, erect.
—3 To measure.
—4 To establish.
—5 To observe, perceive.
—6 Ved. To fix in the earth.

मी I. €9 U. (मीनाति मीनीते; seldom used in classical literature)
—1 To kill, destroy, hurt, injure.
—2 To lessen, diminish.
—3 To change, alter.
—4 To transgress, violate.
—5 To disappear, be lost.
—6 To stray, go astray. ━II. €1 P., €10 U. (मयति, माययति-ते)
—1 To go, move.
—2 To know, understand (गतिमत्योः). ━III. €4 Ā. (मीयते) To
 die, perish; see प्रमी; जन्तोः प्रमीयमाणस्य जीवो नैवोपलभ्यते Mb. 12. 186. 3.
